main_text.l: VII. Finis (inquit Aristot. lib.1.
Politi. cap. 9.) in infinitum expetitur, media
non in infinitum, sed quantum satis est ad
finem acquirendum; itaque Finis est men-
sura mediorum, idque non solum in ratio-
ne quantitatis, sed etiam in ratione quali-
tatis sive bonitatis; ut enim finis per se bo-
nus est, ita media eatenus bona sunt, quate-
nus conducunt ad finem consequendum,
& quae ad finem consequendum plus con-
ferunt, meliora sunt aliis: quod adeo ve-
rum est, ut etiam media quaedam sua na-
tura mala, amentur tamen & expetantur
ut bona, & sint etiam revera bona, quate-
nus conducunt ad obtinendum finem: si
tamen media inhonesta sint, nullius finis
gratia expetenda sunt, quia quod inhonestum
est sua natura, nullius respectu bonum
esse potest.
VIII. Finis solet dividi in finem cujus
& finem cui. Finis cujus dicitur, quem
efficiens expetit: Finis cui, in cujus gra-
tiam sive commodum finis cujus expeti-
tur. Ex.gr. Medicinae finis cujus, est sani-
tas; Cui, aeger: Finis cujus, movet effi-
cientem amore concupiscentiae; Finis cui,
amore benevolentiae: Finis cujus vel est
operatio, vel opus aliquod praeter opera-
tionem, aut usus operis; sic finis Musicae
est, perite canere, finis virtutis,
εὐπραξία[?]; at artium mechanicarum finis, non tam

page.notes: Printed text is in roman type with the Greek word εὐπραξία; its accent and breathing are hard to read in the scan, so the word is marked [?]. Handwritten or pencil marks are present in the text (slashes after "finis" and near "non tam", a bracket near "domum") and are not transcribed. The line "mum," at the foot is the catchword and is given under bottom_margin. The small marks at the bottom left and the Google watermark at the bottom right are not printed text and are left out. The first paragraph's "Politi." is read from "Po-" with the hyphen at the line end and the rest of the word unclear; "Politi." is the reading for "Politic." as printed in the lib. reference, so it is marked here as a plain reading and should be checked against the scan at higher resolution.
